title: Euro Style Toilet Paper Holder 10.15-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass | Dayton Collection Allied Brass
description:
Add a crisp, architectural accent to your bath with this Euro style toilet paper holder made from solid brass. The wall-mounted European tissue holder design uses an open hook so roll changes are quick and easy, and it coordinates with the Dayton collection for a matching Dayton accessory look in modern bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Euro style hook makes changing the roll quick and easy
- Solid brass construction
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean installation
- Available in a wide variety of finishes, including statement colors
- Made in the USA

Specs:
- Collection: Dayton
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 10.15 in (L) x 3.39 in (W/projection) x 2.1 in (H)
- Weight capacity: 1 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: 6
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Search synonyms: toilet paper holder, euro toilet paper holder, European style toilet tissue holder, modern bath accessories, contemporary bath accessories, rectangular bathroom hardware.
